note: 3361 -> 3293, and 41 of the 68 are this change's. Measured against 1e60eda9ce5 in a detached worktree: pristine reads 3334 against the 3361 floor, so 27 were already standing -- this floor has now gone stale in the falling direction three times in one afternoon, at 66b6c590afe, 759ef56a95d and here -- and they are banked so the gate is not left red, not claimed. The 41 are four splits in ir.model.fields, each of which had a defect hiding in the length: `write` into `_check_immutable_attributes` / `_plan_write` / `_rename_column` (see the c901 note); `create`, whose two passes over vals_list became one and whose per-vals `search_count` for a one2many's inverse became a single batched `_check_inverses_exist`; `_prepare_field_attrs`, whose five `return None` boot-ordering guards are now `_is_field_ready` so the method is a pure function of field_data and always returns a dict; and `_compute_display_name`, whose cache-warming half moved to `ir.model._prewarm_names`, the model that owns the cache it was reaching into.
